verdict.rationale: Cua is agent infrastructure, so issuing least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a fair question, but the pack shows no way to mint scoped API keys or tokens for an agent. The nearest items are adjacent controls: driver permissions (cua-docs-6), per-item approval of vault access before an agent can use a saved password (cua-docs-17), a daemon env token (cua-docs-9), and team roles for humans (cua-docs-22). None of these is a scoped agent API credential.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
